en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: To teach the basic principles of storing fruit for extended periods. The physiological and biochemical changes which take place during storage are disscused for each of the main fruit crops. Specific responses to controlled atmosphe storage systems when used in conjuction with cold storage.
